scope: six management models; metadata and explicit tenant/state/uniqueness assertions, not all business acceptance

constraints.name: AccessRequest_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: AccessRequest_requester_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "requesterId") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: AccessRequest_reviewer_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "reviewerId") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: AccessRequest_service_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "serviceId") REFERENCES "Service"("tenantId", id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: AccessRequest_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (version > 0) AND (((status = 'pending'::text) AND ("reviewerId" IS NULL) AND ("resolvedAt" IS NULL) AND ("decisionNote" = ''::text)) OR ((status = 'cancelled'::text) AND ("reviewerId" IS NULL) AND ("resolvedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("decisionNote" = ''::text)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'rejected'::text])) AND ("reviewerId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("resolvedAt" IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.name: AccessRequest_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Company_closure_request_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("closureRequestedAt" IS NULL) AND ("closureReasonCipher" IS NULL) AND ("closureRequestedById" IS NULL)) OR (("closureRequestedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("closureReasonCipher" IS NOT NULL) AND ("closureRequestedById" IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: Company_closure_requested_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, "closureRequestedById") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", "userId") ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Company_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: Company_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'suspended'::text, 'closing'::text, 'closed'::text])))

constraints.name: CompanyBusinessFile_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'deleted'::text) AND ("nameCipher" IS NULL) AND (mime IS NULL) AND (size = 0) AND (sha256 IS NULL) AND ("storageKey" IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'deleted'::text) AND ("nameCipher" IS NOT NULL) AND (mime = ANY (ARRAY['application/pdf'::text, 'image/png'::text, 'image/jpeg'::text])) AND (size > 0) AND (sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND ("storageKey" IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: CompanyBusinessFile_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: CompanyBusinessFile_size_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((size >= 0) AND (size <= 10485760)))

constraints.name: CompanyBusinessFile_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'deleting'::text, 'deleted'::text])))

constraints.name: CompanyBusinessFile_storageKey_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE ("storageKey")

constraints.name: CompanyBusinessFile_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: CompanyBusinessFile_tenantId_id_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE ("tenantId", id)

constraints.name: Membership_accessKind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("accessKind" = 'direct'::text) AND ("expertAssignmentId" IS NULL)) OR (("accessKind" = 'expert'::text) AND ("expertAssignmentId" IS NOT NULL) AND (role = 'viewer'::"Role"))))

constraints.name: Membership_expertAssignment_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "expertAssignmentId", "userId") REFERENCES "ExpertAssignment"("tenantId", id, "expertUserId") ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Membership_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: Membership_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'suspended'::text, 'revoked'::text])))

constraints.name: Membership_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Membership_userId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Service_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: Service_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'archived'::text])))

constraints.name: Service_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ServiceGrant_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: ServiceGrant_tenantId_memberId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "memberId") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: ServiceGrant_tenantId_serviceId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "serviceId") REFERENCES "Service"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
